children.objective: In src/nbody_kernel.cu, test shared-memory staging of source positions and mass so target threads reuse source tiles. Keep the baseline interaction arithmetic and one-target-per-thread mapping as much as practical to isolate the memory change. Explore tile size, loading, synchronization, and permitted launch settings in src/launch.json; handle partial tiles and every valid N correctly. children.objective: In src/nbody_kernel.cu, independently test reducing per-pair arithmetic while retaining direct source loads and baseline target mapping: use the positive target-mass cancellation in acceleration and explicitly evaluate reciprocal-distance-cubed options such as rsqrtf. Preserve the softened distance, update order, exact mass output, and full support for coincident particles and all stated inputs. Require oracle/tolerance validation, including extreme-mass and distributed large-row checks, before comparing official timings.

children.objective: With direct global source loads and baseline interaction arithmetic, investigate target ownership and launch geometry: block size, items_per_block, and one versus multiple output targets per thread/CTA. Respect that items_per_block is not a kernel argument; derive safe, complete output coverage from n and gridDim.x, masking tails without omissions or duplicates for arbitrary sizes and allowed configurations. Measure the configuration changes with correctness checks and the official timing protocol.
